old_claims.decisive_evidence: Old report Section 4; B/I Section 5; weighted root exception, actual area formula, fixed-N box limit, nonuniform strict gain.

old_claims.claim: The complete shared p=1,2 law-to-Jacobian inference is verified by the stated analytic chain.
